description: This file defines the 'Potentials' module class for a CRM system, including methods for managing potential record listings, relationships with other modules (like Contacts, Quotes, SalesOrder), export, history, and dependency handling within a Vtiger or similar CRM environment.

classes.name: Potentials
classes.description: CRMEntity class for managing 'Potentials' (sales opportunities) within the CRM system. Handles data retrieval, relationship management, export, history, and dependency unlinking related to Potential records.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Placeholder method for saving the module; currently does nothing.

methods.name: create_list_query
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query to list 'Potentials' records based on order and where conditions, considering user privileges.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query for exporting Potential data in CSV format, respecting user permissions.

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves the list of contacts related to a specific potential record.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Retrieves related tasks and events for a specific potential record.

methods.name: get_products
methods.description: Fetches products associated with a given potential.

methods.name: get_stage_history
methods.description: Provides the history of sales stages for a potential, including amount, probability, and close date.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Retrieves recent activities related to the potential, such as completed or deferred tasks and events.

methods.name: get_quotes
methods.description: Gets quotes linked to a specific potential record.

methods.name: get_salesorder
methods.description: Returns sales orders associated with the given potential.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related entities (activities, contacts, products, etc.) from a list of source entities to a target entity.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Generates the secondary SQL query part needed for reporting involving potentials.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Defines relation tables used for associating other modules with potentials.

methods.name: unlinkDependencies
methods.description: Removes dependencies (like activities) associated with a potential record.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Unlinks a potential record from another entity such as Accounts, Campaigns, Products, Contacts, or general relationships.

methods.name: save_related_module
methods.description: Creates relationships between potentials and other modules like Contacts and Products.
